manual_steps.title: Regular windows are untouched

manual_steps.note: the leak suite tests the same mechanisms locally; the public sites stay an optional manual cross-check
manual_steps.title: No IP, DNS, WebRTC or IPv6 leak (leak sites)

manual_steps.note: every packet is captured in a namespace where only Tor may leave
manual_steps.title: Watch the wire

manual_steps.note: tor is killed: pages must fail with a proxy error; after a restart no MoltNet window returns
manual_steps.title: Fail-closed

manual_steps.note: a regular-profile cookie doesn't show in MoltNet; a MoltNet cookie is gone after the last window closes
manual_steps.title: Separate identity

manual_steps.note: new profile, cookies gone, new canvas key; the exit IP check needs the public internet
manual_steps.title: New Identity

manual_steps.note: different SOCKS usernames per site, read from the loopback capture and Tor's circuit list
manual_steps.title: Per-site circuits

manual_steps.note: --proxy-server blocks MoltNet; the extension-set proxy case is manual
manual_steps.title: Overrides are refused

manual_steps.note: the circuit's fingerprints are in the consensus Tor downloaded; the onionoo lookup is optional
manual_steps.title: The relays are real

manual_steps.note: http:// and https:// onions load; the Onion-Location bar is browser UI and stays manual
manual_steps.title: Onion sites

manual_steps.note: the interstitial shows and no onion name is looked up; DoH is covered because every lookup lands on the kit's resolver
manual_steps.title: No onion names outside Tor (regular window)

manual_steps.note: a logging proxy must see no onion request (image, fetch, redirect, WebSocket, dedicated and shared worker); the service worker case is manual
manual_steps.title: No onion names to a proxy (regular window)

manual_steps.note: seeded regular-profile settings (Do Not Track, fonts, language, third-party cookies, a blocked JavaScript site) must not show in MoltNet
manual_steps.title: Your settings don't follow you

manual_steps.note: a test extension allowed in Incognito must not see or mark MoltNet pages; split mode, shortcuts and the toolbar stay manual
manual_steps.title: Extensions stay out

manual_steps.note: autoplay policy, persist(), third-party cookies and Shared Storage are read in MoltNet; media engagement, bookmarks and certificate exceptions need a prepared regular profile
manual_steps.title: No regular-profile carry-over
